title: The path from idea to
description: 5 clear steps — no chaos, hidden stages, or unnecessary stress. You always know where we are in the process.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.description: You message us via a convenient messenger — tell us about your business, task, and audience. We listen and ask the right questions.

steps.title: Brief & Script
steps.description: We turn the idea into structure: concept, script, moodboard, and a clear shooting plan. Everything is approved with you.

steps.title: Shoot Day
steps.description: We come to you or choose a location. Sound, light, framing — every detail is controlled by the team.

steps.title: Editing & Post-production
steps.description: We build the story: editing, graphics, music, and color grading. Every second matters.

steps.title: Final & Revisions
steps.description: We present the result, refine details based on your feedback, and deliver the final file in any format.
